def snap(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def blk(r0,r1,c0,c1):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if a[r][c] in ('b','S')]

    from collections import Counter
    def tmaj(r0,c0): return Counter(a[r][c] for r in range(r0,r0+3) for c in range(c0,c0+3)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return {'top':blk(9,15,26,40),'bot':blk(34,39,26,40),

def timer(f): return sum(1 for r in range(64) if f.ascii.split('\n')[r][62]=='N')
